title: Members sign in with Google; outsiders are refused
description:
```gherkin
Feature: Signing in
  Scenario: A member signs in with Google and sees the catalog
    Given "rap@endymion.com" is on the allowed list
    When they sign in with Google
    Then they are in the "members" group and can list clips

  Scenario: An outsider is refused
    Given "stranger@example.com" is not on the allowed list
    When they try to sign up with Google
    Then the sign-up is rejected
```
